name: Justin Aanenson
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Justin Aanenson is the founding attorney of Truce Law, PLLC; a Washington family law firm with offices in Seattle, Tacoma and Olympia. He is a trained collaborative law attorney and a certified mediator, handling divorces and other interwoven family matters in and out of the courtroom. He was licensed to practice law in Washington courts in 2012.

A friendly and fierce advocate for his clients, Mr. Aanenson is known for finding creative solutions and strategies to deal with the emotional and often complex issues posed by a family law matter. Throughout the legal process, he provides his clients with helpful advice that takes them through all the challenges of divorce. Clients benefit from his ability to work with them in any situation, his knowledge of the law and his extensive experience with similar cases.

With a bachelor’s degree in finance and marketing from the University of Washington, Mr. Aanenson earned his Juris Doctor from the Seattle University School of Law. He was one of the Washington State Scholars who were awarded scholarships based on an exceptional aptitude for the study of law, along with a strong history of service or commitment to issues relevant to the mission of the Seattle University School of Law. An Avvo “Superb” rated attorney, Mr. Aanenson derives great pleasure from his involvement in law-related organizations and service to his community.
honors: The Washington State Scholars Scholarship is available to students entering Seattle University, School of Law. They must be in the top one percent of the applicant pool and be a resident of Washington. Also, they must demonstrate exceptional aptitude for the study of law, and have a strong history of service and/or commitment to issues relevant to the mission of the school to be eligible for this award. , Washington State Scholar , Seattle University School of Law , 2012
